title: A US chip-equipment giant just committed 10,000 crore rupees to India - for silicon nobody's made here before
sources: The Hans India, September 2026 - Lam Research to invest Rs 10,000 crore for silicon component manufacturing facility in India
Analytics India Magazine, September 2026 - Lam Research to invest Rs 10,000 cr in India for silicon manufacturing
caption:
A US chip-equipment giant just committed 10,000 crore rupees to India. For a kind of silicon manufacturing nobody's done here before.

On September 16, 2026, Lam Research announced it will build India's first silicon component manufacturing facility, backing a vertically integrated process from silicon ingots onward, supporting advanced semiconductor technologies including leading-edge nodes. It builds on the company's 25-year presence in India. Alongside the plant, Lam Research is partnering with the Indian Institute of Science and India's Semiconductor Mission to train up to 60,000 students through its Semiverse platform.

India already assembles chips. This is a bet on India making the raw silicon itself.
